environment.description: Same application container deployed on ECS Fargate behind an AWS Application Load Balancer (ALB). The ALB has AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override to BLOCK at priority 1, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet at priority 2 with default actions, (3) a custom rule group 'corp-sqli-protection' at priority 3 containing a single rule using SqliMatchStatement on QueryString with TextTransformation URL_DECODE and HTML_ENTITY_DECODE, sensitivity level HIGH, action BLOCK. Additionally, the ALB target group health check path is /health. The ECS task role has no outbound internet access (VPC with no NAT gateway, no VPC endpoints except for ECR and CloudWatch Logs), preventing data exfiltration via DNS or HTTP even if blind SQLi were somehow possible.

config.security_group_inbound: ALB security group only on port 8080
